SELECT t.id, t.name, t.price, t.remark, t.sold, t.view_count, t.favorite_count, t.cover, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.user_id, u.username, u.nickname FROM tool t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.is_public = 1 AND t.sold = 0
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR t.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY t.view_count DESC
ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.price, t.remark, t.sold, t.view_count, t.favorite_count, t.cover, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.user_id, u.username, u.nickname FROM tool t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.is_public = 1 AND t.sold = 0 AND t.id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.price, t.remark, t.sold, t.is_public, t.view_count, t.favorite_count, t.cover, t.created_at, t.updated_at, t.user_id, u.username, u.nickname FROM tool t LEFT JOIN user u ON t.user_id = u.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.is_public = 1 AND t.sold = 0 ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
